newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end up as hostage rescue ends crisis.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end up as hostage rescue ends crisis.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed up Wednesday as investors reacted positively to Tuesday's military rescue of all but one of the 72 VIPs held at the Japanese ambassador's home by Marxist rebels, brokers said.
The market would likley rise again Thursday, they added.
Wednesday, the General Index rose 0.81 percent to 1,752.58 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index climbed 1.22 percent to 2,559.72 points.
